text_zh: 时之沙逆流而上——引擎已觉察汝之临近
text_en: Time-sand flows backward—the Engine senses thy approach

text_zh: 每一祷击皆需献祭——铅字饥渴如火
text_en: Each keystroke demands sacrifice—the letters hunger

text_zh: 引擎心跳渐急，时流如注——其苏醒在即
text_en: The Engine's pulse quickens—awakening draws near

text_zh: 震颤寒彻骨髓——每次失误，冰霜愈厚
text_en: Tremor breeds frost—each error deepens the ice

text_zh: 汝之成功即汝之枷锁——时光倒影已成
text_en: Thy success becomes thy chain—the mirror is cast

text_zh: "沙漏倾泻，汝铭日消"
text_en: "The hourglass empties, thy inscription fades"

text_zh: "词有尽头，铅亦有界"
text_en: "Every word has its boundary, every lead its limit"

text_zh: "引擎之门槛既高且深"
text_en: "The Engine's gates stand twice as high"

text_zh: "后续祷文，声愈微弱"
text_en: "Each following prayer grows fainter still"

text_zh: "引擎索其应得之份"
text_en: "The Engine claims what is owed to it"

text_zh: 「汝所铸之铭愈稀，血愈浓。」
text_en: "The thinner thy inscriptions, the thicker the blood."

text_zh: 「字未成而先逝，如烛遇风。」
text_en: "Letters die before they live, as flame meets wind."

text_zh: 「铅字自乱其序，键徒循其迷踪。」
text_en: "The letters disorder themselves; follow their maze."

text_zh: 「末字为首，首字为终——逆流而铭。」
text_en: "Last becomes first, first becomes last—inscribe against the current."

text_zh: 「墨中有刺，字间藏针。」
text_en: "Thorns in the ink, needles between letters."

text_zh:
内部备忘
收件：第 VII 层工程部
发件：热力监测组
主题：砂芯异常磨损（第 ██ 次跟进）

该层计时沙漏砂芯消耗量超出工厂规范 ██ 倍。供应商确认砂料质量无异常。现场检查显示沙漏外观正常，漏斗通径符合图纸，砂粒粒径在公差范围内。

D-████ 至 D-████ 报告"时间过得很快"。值班日志显示各项作业按时完成。但沙漏需要每 ██ 分钟重新装填。

已向采购部申请增加砂料储备。审批状态：待定。
签名：工程师 ████
text_en:
Internal Memorandum
To: Layer VII Engineering
From: Thermal Monitoring
Re: Sand Core Abnormal Consumption (██th Follow-up)

Hourglass sand core consumption exceeds factory specifications by ██ times. Supplier confirms sand quality shows no anomalies. Field inspection shows hourglass appearance normal, funnel diameter per blueprint, grain size within tolerance.

D-████ through D-████ report "time goes quickly." Duty logs show all operations completed on schedule. But hourglasses require refilling every ██ minutes.

Requested increased sand reserves from Procurement. Approval status: Pending.
Signed: Engineer ████
_aiIssues: 砂芯/砂料术语略显现代工业感

text_zh:
设备维护工单 #M-████
区域：第 ██ 层键座区
报告日期：M.2██.███

键徒反映"按键时手指发麻"。电气组检查线路，绝缘层完好。机械组检查弹簧，压感正常。

异常现象：键徒铭刻时偶有停顿。本人称"手不听使唤"。医疗组体检显示神经反射正常。键座传动机构运行正常。

工程师 Voss 注：该现象在铸出圣流后更明显。铅水供应管道压力稳定。推测为操作疲劳。

处理方案：增加轮班间隔至 ██ 分钟。
签名：[空白]
状态：工单已关闭
text_en:
Equipment Maintenance Order #M-████
Area: Layer ██ Lectern Section
Report Date: M.2██.███

Operators report "fingers go numb when pressing keys." Electrical team checked circuits, insulation intact. Mechanical team checked springs, pressure sensitivity normal.

Anomalous phenomenon: Operators occasionally pause during inscription. Subject claims "hands won't obey." Medical examination shows normal neural reflexes. Lectern transmission mechanisms operating normally.

Engineer Voss notes: Phenomenon more pronounced after casting sacred humours. Lead supply pipeline pressure stable. Presumed operational fatigue.

Solution: Increase shift intervals to ██ minutes.
Signed: [blank]
Status: Work order closed
_aiIssues: '手不听使唤'略显口语化，与公文体不符
工程师 Voss 姓名过于现代
_aiSuggestion: 将'手不听使唤'改为'肢体控制异常'，工程师署名可用 ████ 遮蔽

text_zh:
异常事件跟进报告 F-017-██

发生地点: 第 XI 层，主铸炉区
初始记录: M.2██.██.██

D-████ 在标准收容铭刻期间报告「感觉变快了」。生理监测显示心率、体温正常。工作台沙漏计时正常。

后续观察: 该人员完成单次铭刻用时与基准一致，但自述「感觉只用了一半时间」。连续 ██ 日测试，主观与客观时间感知持续分离。

附带现象: 同区域其他 D 级人员陆续出现类似报告。工程部检修时间计量设备，未发现故障。

现状: 已将第 XI 层列为「感知差异可接受区域」。人员轮换周期维持标准。
text_en:
Anomalous Event Follow-up Report F-017-██

Location: Layer XI, Primary Casting Floor
Initial Record: M.2██.██.██

D-████ reported "feeling faster" during standard containment inscription. Biometric readings show normal heart rate and temperature. Workstation hourglass timing normal.

Subsequent Observation: Subject completes single inscription in baseline time but claims "felt like half the time." Continuous ██-day testing shows persistent divergence between subjective and objective temporal perception.

Incidental Phenomena: Other D-Class personnel in same sector report similar experiences. Engineering inspected chronometric equipment, found no malfunction.

Current Status: Layer XI designated "Acceptable Perceptual Variance Zone." Personnel rotation cycle maintained at standard intervals.

text_zh:
内部备忘
发件：第VII层工程部
收件：排字监督处
主题：铅字配额异常（第██次跟进）

连续██日内，该区域铅字铸出量恒定为预定额度之██%。工程部检修铸炉、字盘、传动机械，指标均正常。排字监督处确认操作者技术评定无异常。

操作者D-████报告："每个字都铸得出，但铸到一半就停了，像有什么在数。"铅炉燃料充足，模具无损，但日产量曲线于每日同一时刻截止。

建议将此现象列为'可接受异常'。审批状态：待定。
text_en:
Internal Memo
From: Layer VII Engineering
To: Typesetting Oversight
Re: Lead Quota Anomaly (██th Follow-up)

For ██ consecutive days, lead glyph output in this sector remains constant at ██% of designated quota. Engineering has inspected furnaces, type beds, and drive mechanisms - all readings nominal. Typesetting Oversight confirms operator skill assessments show no anomalies.

Operator D-████ reports: "Every letter casts fine, but halfway through it just stops, like something's counting." Furnace fuel adequate, molds undamaged, yet daily output curves terminate at identical intervals.

Recommend classifying this phenomenon as 'acceptable anomaly.' Approval status: pending.

text_zh:
区域限制通知
第██层收容廊 - 门牌编号████至████
生效日期：M.2██年██月██日

近期该区段沙漏计量出现异常读数。标准收容基准保持不变，但沙漏显示双倍额度后方可通行。工程部确认计量机械校准无误。

D级人员报告："门槛好像升高了，但是没人告诉我们升高了多少。"已安排技术评估小组调查。小组于██日进入该区域后失联。

临时措施：延长轮班时长至标准时限双倍。替补人员已按§4.2调配至邻近区段。

签名：[工程主管] [排字监督] [空白]
text_en:
Area Restriction Notice
Layer ██ Containment Corridors - Door Numbers ████ to ████
Effective Date: M.2██/██/██

Recent anomalous readings in sector hourglass measurements. Standard containment thresholds remain unchanged, but hourglasses display double quotas before permitting passage. Engineering confirms measurement apparatus calibration nominal.

D-class personnel report: "The bar seems higher, but nobody told us how much higher." Technical assessment team dispatched for investigation. Team entered sector on ██th, subsequently lost contact.

Interim measures: Extend shift duration to double standard time limits. Replacement personnel reassigned to adjacent sectors per §4.2.

Signatures: [Chief Engineer] [Typesetting Supervisor] [blank]
_aiIssues: '门槛好像升高了'口语感稍强

text_zh:
站点备忘：第 ██ 层铅账异常（多次跟进）

收件：铸字坊主事处
发件：计量部

本层铅字造册出现持续偏差。所有键徒报告的铭分记录与中央计数器显示值存在差异。现象始于 M.2██年第 ██ 月，初时偏差微小，现已扩大至无法忽略程度。

已核查设备：计数器校准正常，铅字称重无误。键徒手工复算结果与自述数值一致。中央设备与人员记录均显示正确，但两者始终不符。

近期该层人员轮调频率上升 ██%。原因：铭分不足。D 级人员抱怨'数字被偷了'，已按 §4.2 忽略主观描述。

建议暂缓该层铭分考核。审批状态：待定。
text_en:
Site Memorandum: Layer ██ Lead Count Discrepancy (11th Follow-up)

To: Typesetting Workshop Authority
From: Measurement Division

Persistent variance observed in layer's type census. All keybound personnel report inscription tallies inconsistent with central counter readings. Phenomenon commenced M.2██ month ██, initially minor, now expanded beyond acceptable margins.

Equipment verified: Counters calibrated properly, lead weights confirm accuracy. Manual recalculation by keybound matches their reported values. Central systems and personnel records both show correct operation, yet results persistently diverge.

Recent personnel rotation increased ██% on this layer. Cause: Insufficient inscription count. D-Class subjects claim 'numbers are being stolen.' Subjective descriptions ignored per §4.2.

Recommend suspension of inscription quotas for this layer. Approval status: Pending.
_aiIssues: 多次跟进应为'第██次跟进'格式统一
铭分记录与铅账异常术语混用
_aiSuggestion: 将'数字被偷了'改为'计数出现差额'，统一跟进次数格式，明确铅账vs铭分的术语使用

text_zh:
设备维护工单 #M-████

部门：工程维护科
报告员：Technician L-████
区域：第 ██ 层圣流导管区

例行检查发现两条主要圣流管道内壁出现异常沉积。沉积物呈深棕色，质地类似凝固的蜡质物。管道流量测试显示正常，但下游铭文组反馈功率不足。

已按标准程序清理管道，沉积物 6 小时内重新形成。更换管道后，沉积现象转移至新管道。工程分析：管道本身无异常，问题可能在流体性质。

该层键徒报告铭文组铸出'感觉很重'。多数人员描述为'墨水变稠了'，但流体检测显示粘度正常。

建议增加冲洗频率至每日数次。
签名：[该栏已填写但字迹模糊不清]
text_en:
Maintenance Work Order #M-████

Department: Engineering Maintenance
Reporter: Technician L-████
Area: Layer ██ Humour Conduit Zone

Routine inspection revealed anomalous deposits on inner walls of two primary humour pipes. Deposits appear dark brown, consistency resembling congealed wax. Pipeline flow tests show normal rates, yet downstream inscription arrays report insufficient power.

Standard cleaning procedures executed, deposits reformed within 6 hours. After pipeline replacement, phenomenon transferred to new conduits. Engineering analysis: Pipelines themselves show no abnormality, issue may lie in fluid properties.

Keybound personnel on this layer report inscription casting feels 'heavy.' Majority describe sensation as 'ink has thickened,' though fluid viscosity tests normal.

Recommend increasing flush frequency to thrice daily.
Signature: [Line filled but handwriting illegible]
_aiIssues: '墨水变稠了'过于现代化表达
Technician L-████ 职称格式不符合D级编号规范
_aiSuggestion: 将'墨水变稠了'改为'圣流质地异常'，技术员编号应符合站点编号规范

text_zh:
区域限制通知

生效范围：第 ██ 层东侧走廊
发布部门：安全管理处

该区域内键座出现间歇性字符显示异常。现象表现为：特定铅字符在操作过程中逐渐变得模糊，最终完全消失。消失顺序固定：先外围字符，后中心区域。持续时间约 ██ 分钟。

现象不影响铭刻操作。键徒反馈：'键还在，但看不见了'。触觉确认键位正常，仅视觉显示受影响。

已安排 D-████ 至 D-████ 执行该区域作业。人员配备：双倍。理由：单人作业时失误率上升 ██%。工作安排：伙伴监视，互相提醒键位。

暂无设备更换计划。该现象已持续 ██ 个月，设备运转未受实质损害。

有效期：直至另行通知。
text_en:
Area Restriction Notice

Effective Range: Layer ██ Eastern Corridor
Issuing Department: Security Administration

Intermittent character display anomalies observed in area's key lecterns. Phenomenon manifests as: Specific lead glyphs gradually blur during operation, eventually disappearing completely. Disappearance sequence consistent: Outer characters first, then central area. Duration approximately ██ minutes.

Phenomenon does not impair inscription procedure. Keybound feedback: 'Keys remain, but cannot be seen.' Tactile confirmation shows normal key positioning, only visual display affected.

D-████ through D-████ assigned to area operations. Personnel allocation: Double standard. Reason: Solo operation error rate increased ██%. Work arrangement: Partner observation, mutual key position reminders.

No equipment replacement scheduled. Phenomenon has persisted ██ months, equipment operation not substantially impaired.

Effective until further notice.
_aiIssues: '键还在，但看不见了'略显口语
